##### Project general facts

Berkeley Place is a contemporary residential development, featuring 12-storey configuration. The project offers a selection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, designed with a modern architectural approach that emphasizes clean lines, open layouts, and abundant natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows, light color palettes, and spacious balconies with glass railings create bright and airy interiors, while offering open views of the surrounding green landscapes.

The development provides a comprehensive range of amenities across the ground floor, podium levels, and rooftop, creating a fully integrated lifestyle environment. Residents can enjoy a landscaped rooftop terrace with a luxury swimming pool, as well as a lobby featuring lounge areas, a library, co-working spaces, and a game room with access to an outdoor terrace. Additional facilities include a basketball court, bicycle parking, EV charging stations, landscaped gardens, and dedicated recreational areas, ensuring a balanced and active living experience.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, maintaining a modern and elegant design throughout. The kitchens are equipped with built-in appliances and feature stylish cabinetry along with functional kitchen islands. The units are delivered unfurnished, offering residents the flexibility to personalize their living spaces according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Meydan, an extraordinary community in the heart of Dubai known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. The area offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment across its expansive landscape. The community is renowned for its iconic racecourse, which hosts prestigious events including the Dubai World Cup, creating an aura of excitement and elegance that attracts enthusiasts from around the world.

The neighborhood features expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards that create a serene and refreshing environment for residents to enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, and picnics. The abundance of open spaces provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a strong sense of community and well-being. The area's thoughtful design integrates green spaces throughout, ensuring that nature is always within reach.

The community's central location offers excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. Residents can conveniently explore the city's vibrant attractions, business districts, and cultural landmarks. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of luxury living, natural beauty, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.u
